<@ba.rem>Swap between performing on the <@ba.vup>piano (starting)</> and <@ba.vup>organ</> timbres.</>
<@ba.vup>Piano</>: ATK <@ba.vup>+{attack@atk:0%}</>, notes fly faster; notes pierce enemies, dealing <@ba.vup>Physical damage</>
<@ba.vup>Organ</>: ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack@attack_speed}</>, notes deal <@ba.vup>Arts damage</> and fly slower
<@ba.rem>During <$ba.fever>Fever</>, the current timbre deals double strikes</>
